newsitem.title: USA: Limited asserts zero tolerance for fraud.
newsitem.headline: Limited asserts zero tolerance for fraud.

text.p: Limited Inc said Thursday that, though it has not had time to review details of a lawsuit filed against it by the American Textile Manufacturers Institute, the company has "zero tolerance for any violation of our policies or any law."
Tarrant Apparel Group said Thursday that it and Limited were named in the civil suit filed in U.S. District Court in Los Angeles.
The lawsuit alleges, among other things, that the defendants filed improper statements about the country of origin of imported merchandise with the United States Customs Service, Tarrant said.
"The Limited is committed to full compliance with the spirit and letter of all legal requirements relating to the importation of goods into the United Sattes," a statement issued by the company said.
The complaint seeks unspecified monetary damages, Tarrant said.
Tarrant said it has monitoring procedures to ensure strict compliance with requirements of the U.S. Customs Service and the company does not tolerate violation of any law.
